behavior: Explicit local pairing plist becomes one password-protected host P12 and the existing App importer nine-key public configuration. No discovery, network, plaintext private-key output, password argv/environment, or raw pairing logging. Validates certificate dates/signatures and Host key matching. New output directory only; identity-aware rollback preserves replacement files/directories and explicitly reports incomplete cleanup.

finalIndependentReview.scope: Only the directory-owner publication/rollback hunk, its new synthetic regression and the added existing-App UI prerequisite text

limitations: The change is ordinary rollback ownership protection, not an atomic filesystem defense against a replacement between every syscall.
The earlier six-method synthetic crypto/schema review remains separately recorded and was not repeated.
No iOS import, real pairing, endpoint reachability, installation or automatic renewal was established by this review.
